periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal, approximately 45 degrees relative to the snout-to-forehead axis, oriented toward the zygomatic region.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid, with a visual length approximately twice the width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering toward the lower outer quadrant, creating a teardrop-shaped elongation.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, smooth U-shape along the posterior margin as it transitions to the lateral flank.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High, covering approximately one-third of the visible lateral torso length.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced reddish-brown tinting in the fur of the ventral region and limb pads; open-mouth vocalization/yawn posture exposing teeth and tongue.
